segments.text: Now can text of another sutra, third sutra.
Manu, Gyanam prakashakam loke, atma chayv prakashaka, anu yur apratak bhavat, gyani, gyani prakashati.
He put the question first.
It is said already in Shastras, it is defined that knowledge is also unlightening,
and Atma is also unlightening.
Atma is as good as knowledge.
Knowledge and Atma are one in reality.
Yet actually we gyani bairavokta drestya anu yur apratak bhavat.
So these are one, knowledge and the knower, Atma.
Knowledge is also filled with enlightenment.
So knowledge can enlighten you in each and every way.
And the knower also can enlighten you.
So knower and knowledge are one in real sense.
Anu yur apratak bhavat.
These are reality, one.
These are not differentiated.
These are not different to aspects of being.
This is one aspect of being.
Gyani, gyani prakashati.
In knowledge you find the residents of knower.
In knower you find the residents of knowledge.
So knowledge and knower are one.
It is said in vikyana bairava, in this way.
Gyanam api prakashamayama eva.
So there you find knowledge is also filled with enlightenment.
Knowledge can only enlighten you, not deprive you from enlightenment.
Yet katamasi banduru patam.
How you have explained in this sutra that it is bondage.
Knowledge is bondage.
Each and every knowledge is bondage for being here.
Sattavita.
To this he answers, it is in agreement.
He says there is agreement in this.
I accept that this is correct theory, that knowledge and knower are one.
But only then when Paramashable Prasadath evam pratyabit ghaitha.
When by the grace of Lord, you know it.
You know it that this whole universe is filled with knowledge and knower.
And knowledge and knower are one.
And this and I is one being.
If you know it, then it is not bondage.
If you don't know it, then it is bondage.
Yadat u tanmaya shakti to nae evam yumarsha.
When by the energy of his illusion, shakti, you are not aware this way.
Then what happens?
Kaladinam tattanam avivyakomaya.
Then all these thirty one elements.
Beginning from color, ending in, ending in what?
Ending in Praty, earth.
Kala is the beginning of samsara.
The earth is the end, end of samsara.
These are thirty one elements in the state, in the world of illusion.
In the world of enlightenment there are five elements.
Shuddhvidya, eshwar, sadashiv, shakti and shiv.
These five elements are pure.
And these thirty one elements are impure, filled with ignorance.
Then you are not aware in this way that everything is filled with knower and knowledge in divinity.
By which way you find that knower is inside knowledge and knowledge is inside knower.
If you don't understand it, if you are not aware of it, then what happens?
These thirty one elements are there.
You live in these thirty one elements.
And while living, you cannot possess the undifferentiated knowledge of thirty one elements.
Avyakomaya, you are not aware of possessing the undifferentiated knowledge of these thirty one elements.
The possessing the undifferentiated knowledge of thirty one elements,
you used to see that these thirty one elements are one with these pure five elements.
There are no other than these five shuddh elements, shuddhada.
When it is not done, then there is the kingdom of Maya,
kingdom of Maya, not sad and shakti.
Otherwise there is kingdom of sad and shakti.
Then it is known as one with that supreme being of five elements.
From shuddhada with there to shiva, then it becomes divine.
When it becomes divine, then these thirty one elements are only the expansion of your saatant shakti.
When it is not done like this, then these thirty one elements are the expansion of illusushakt, Maya.
Kinshid-katrata, the Rupa, Kalai, the Kitten tanam, Tattanam.
Kinshid-katrata is the aspect of first Kalah, first first element of ignorance.
First element of coming down from your own real nature is Kalah.
That is Kinshid-katrata, being disconnected from from the from possessing the energy
of all doing, you possess the energy of some doing.
You are disconnected with the possession of all knowing,
you are attached to possess the energy of some knowledge in this way.
In this way you come down in the world of limitation by and by.
Kinshid-katrata, the Rupa, Kalai, the Kitten tanam.
And in the end, you enter in the state of earthly earth.
Earth is the most grossest state of samsara.
Tattanam, Kanchuku puristaka, Tholadehatiena, Avastitana.
First is Kanchuka, Kanchuka is six coverings.
Then puristaka means...
Five tanmatras, Man, Buddha and Ankara.
Then Tholadehatiena.
Then five organs of knowledge, five organs of action and so on.
Avastitana, all these elements, all these group of elements,
when you are in Ayurveda, when you don't know undifferentiatedly.
Then you know these differentiatedly.
You know that they are different from your real nature.
They are not one with that.
Prasakta, Ayumatana, Meva.
Although they are one with that.
Aprataka, Atma, Tena, Pratipati.
You know that you are one with that.
But the reality of being is not one with that.
God is not one with that. You are one with that.
You are one with your body.
God is not one with your body.
When you know in such a way, then you have come down.
When you know that all bodies are my bodies.
All bodies are universal bodies and I possess universal body.
I am God.
Then you are elevated.
There is no question of getting yourself down in this world of ignorance.
And that is Maya.
Maya is tattva akhati maya prapanja.
Coming down in such a way when you are absolutely deprived of your real nature.
It is said in Tantrasadbhava.
Kalo valita chaitanya.
When you are God consciousness.
When you are chaitanya.
Chaitanya means God consciousness is Udvalita.
Udvalita means fenced.
Fenced by Kala.
Fenced by Kala. Kala means doing in limited form.
In limited way, when you do in limited way.
When you know in limited way.
When you love in limited way.
When you live in limited way.
When you possess in limited way.
These are five coverings.
By these five coverings, your God consciousness is fenced.
You cannot go out of this fence.
Kala udvalita chaitanya.
Kala does not mean only Kala.
Kala means all these five coverings.
Vidya darshita gochara.
And that limited knowledge.
The function of limited knowledge is to guide you in a limited way of treading on the path.
You tread on the path in a limited way.
Raghane rancita atmasa.
Raghara does this function.
It makes you attached to that path.
If fortunately some great soul happens to meet you and wants you to take out of that limited path.
You won't accept going out from that limited path because you are attached to it.
It has done, it is the function of raga which has done to you being attached to it.
You don't like to come out from that limited path.
This is the function of raga.
Vidya dhikarna ir yuta.
And you are attached with intellectual organs, organs of action and organs of knowledge.
On this path.
Eva maya atma ko bandha proh tas taisya dharatma ka.
It is hence this limited way of your world of illusion is bondage.
To you who is always situated in fear, in the world of fear, dharatma ka.
It is not uddharatma ka.
You should correct it.
It is not tasya, in the place of tasya you must put tasya, tasya dharatma ka.
To him this bandha is filled with fearfulness.
He is always afraid.
One dies and he thinks another may die.
He dies and he thinks another may die.
Somebody else may die.
Another relative may die.
What can he do?
He dies.
Another relative may die.
So he is always filled with this fearfulness.
He is not secured.
He is not secured.
There is no security.
Yes.
So it is dharatma ka.
In place of uddharatma ka it is not correct.
Dharatma ka is correct.
Tadashai-guno dharma dharma-cheva samasata.
So in brief words, doing right or doing wrong is always function by him.
He sometimes does wrong things.
Sometimes does right things.
Not knowingly.
It does not know what he is doing because he is deprived of that
the dignity of joy.
That the dignity of joy has taken its end full land.
When he becomes attached to these limited ways of life and his fenced
and his god consciousness is fenced altogether.
So that god consciousness is not found anymore.
Tathrasa samasata paasya paasata is the tithi tithi.
So in that sense he is entangled and he has become just like a beast.
And this energy of Illituya energy of Lord has entangled him altogether.
So it is Illituya energy of knowledge that makes him do this and that.
So, he is absolutely dependent to that energy, dependent to that illusion energy.
In Spanda Shastra, it is also narrated in this Shloka.
Upra buddha dhiyas te te sastiti thagunodhiyata, those whose intellect has not risen,
whose intellect is deprived of awareness. Upra buddha dhiyas, these energies, all energies,
all energies of action, all energies of knowledge, all energies of intellect, but those who
are absolutely aware of their own being, these energies make them attached to God consciousness.
These energies, Upra buddha dhiyas te te sastiti thagunodhiyata, those who are fully aware of God
consciousness. For those, all actions in his daily life, I mean all organs of action,
all organs of cognition and all organs of intellect, lead him to that supreme consciousness of God
consciousness. For those who are aware, who are not aware, for them, these make him deprived of
that God consciousness altogether. So, the function of these organs is in, takes place in two ways.
One for those who are fully aware, one for those who are deprived from awareness.
For those who are deprived from awareness, they become drawn down in the field of ignorance.
For those who are possessing awareness in his fullness, they get elevated all together.
